product_one_liner.value: Vectary is a browser-based design platform that helps designers, architects, marketers and creative teams develop concepts with AI and create interactive 3D presentations and augmented-reality experiences.

employee_band.notes: Based on a reported employee count of 18; LinkedIn provides only the broader 11–50 range.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains product announcements, design tutorials and marketing content, rather than two engineer-authored posts explaining how Vectary is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes tutorials, CAD importing, interactions and API integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job boards show no listed openings; TheJobsMap explicitly dates its no-open-roles statement to November 9, 2026.

model_provider.value: Hunyuan 3.1, Hunyuan 3, Tripo H3.1, Tripo 2.5, Pixal 3D, Trellis 2, Trellis, Meshy 6, Meshy 5 and Rodin 2.
model_provider.notes: These models are explicitly listed for image-to-3D generation.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 certification and ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed funding round is January 2023, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No openings are listed on the cited job boards.

launched_6mo.notes: Vectary Canvas launched on October 15, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile lists the Vectary Chief Revenue Officer role as ending in May 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Documented ecommerce/sales-platform integration only; this does not establish that Vectary uses Shopify internally or identify an internal CRM.
